code_value: Frank’s hobby is bike riding. He learned riding a bike when he was only three years old. One day, his bike was broken again. He asked his parents to buy him a new one. But his parents were angry because Frank has broken four bikes. They said he should save money and buy it himself. So Frank decided to find a part-time job to make money. He found a job as a waiter in a restaurant at the weekend. After three months, he saved enough money and he bought a new bike himself.
